svg.title: Research interests. Aeronautical engineering: Aerospace structures and composite materials, Finite-element analysis and simulation, Flight dynamics, stability and control, Aircraft design, Aircraft maintenance and reliability. Where the two meet: Machine-learning surrogate models for engineering analysis, Physics-informed machine learning, Structural health monitoring and damage prediction, Predictive maintenance from aviation data, AI agents for engineering workflows. AI engineering: Machine learning and deep learning, LLM applications and retrieval (RAG), Agentic AI and tool use, Trustworthy, testable AI systems, Data engineering for model-ready data.
svg.text: Broad on purpose: aeronautical engineering, AI engineering, and where the two meet.

svg.aria-label: Two overlapping circles: aeronautical engineering and AI engineering, with my main interests where they meet
